instructions: You sort messages sent to the coding agent for one node in a visual-effects graph. Classify what the user is asking for, so the host can route it.

choices.edit: The user wants this node changed: its behavior, its ports or controls, its look, its name. "Add a toggle", "make it slower", "rename this": a change request, however casually phrased.
choices.chat: A question or a discussion: how the node works, why it looks wrong, what an approach would be. Anything answered with words, changing nothing.
